name: Unit Of Measure 3 Choice
definition: Specifies a unit of measure with a code or free text.

UnitOfMeasureCode.name: Unit Of Measure Code
UnitOfMeasureCode.definition: Quantity of a product on a line specified by a number. For example, 100 (kgs), 50 (pieces).

OtherUnitOfMeasure.name: Other Unit Of Measure
OtherUnitOfMeasure.definition: Identifies the unit of measure not present in the code list.
